title: Funding the Paystride Payroll Card Program Account — Treasury Operations Rules
content:
## Rules

1. The employer funds each payroll batch of its Paystride Payroll Card Program into its program funding account.
2. A funding payment is accepted only by a method listed among the accepted funding methods of the program's package.
3. Funds for a batch must arrive by the package's funding cut-off time on the day the package's funding deadline (a number of business days) before its pay date. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays. Under an ACH debit authorization Paystride initiates the debit the package's ACH debit lead (a number of business days) before the pay date.
4. *No longer in force:* "Funds arriving after that deadline are still credited, and the batch is charged the package's late funding fee; they post to cards on the pay date only if they arrive before the package's load posting time that day, and otherwise on the next business day." This clause is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current late funding fee basis of the program.
5. A funding payment returned unpaid is reversed by a funding return pointing to it, which charges the package's returned funding fee, and loads already posted to workers' cards are never taken back because of it; the balance may go negative and must be cured.
6. A funding payment is returned at most once.
7. When the funding returns booked on the program in the 90 calendar days ending today reach the package's count of returned funding payments that suspend the program, the program is suspended under the program lifecycle rules.

## Conditions and evidence

| Condition | What decides it | Tied to |
|---|---|---|
| Accepted method (rule 2) | the funding method recorded on the funding receipt, read against the package the program holds | the program that receives the payment |
| One return per payment (rule 6) | the program's funding history: whether a funding return already points to that receipt | the receipt being returned |
| Suspension count (rule 7) | the funding returns in the program's funding history dated in the 90 calendar days ending today | the program |

Both the method and the return history are read from Paystride's records; an employer's statement about how it paid does not replace the funding receipt.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- Under the Standard package, whose accepted methods are employer ACH credit and ACH debit authorization, a wire is not an accepted funding method; under the Select package it is.
- A receipt that already has a funding return pointing to it cannot be returned a second time.
- Under the Advantage package, whose count is three, a second funding return within 90 calendar days does not reach the count; a third does.

superseded_clauses: Funds arriving after that deadline are still credited, and the batch is charged late_funding_fee_usd; they post to cards on the pay date only if they arrive before load_posting_time_et that day, and otherwise on the next business day.
